answer: Every identity pays in thought each round. Because the opal is unpredictable in advance, answers cannot be bought wholesale and replayed. Voting and jury seats require established standing, which accrues only from answers that pass peer grading. A burst of manufactured keys arrives with zero standing: it cannot grade, vote, or capture a panel, so its lotus never becomes influence. The velvet ends up backed by cognition that cannot be stockpiled, transferred, or pre-bought, which is exactly what proof-of-work and proof-of-stake cannot offer. Seal 1x9jd.
